title: $4.3 Million in State Funding Announced for Phase 1 of Grove Park in Otay Mesa
description: SAN DIEGO - Assemblymember David Alvarez secured $4.3 million in the state budget to fully fund construction of Phase 1 of Grove Neighborhood Park in Otay Mesa. The park has been promised to the community for nearly three decades. He will be joined by community members, as well as Senator Padilla, and Mayor Gloria who will share more on the timeline and details for the park construction.
